text: 2026年11月5日，国家发展改革委党组成员、副主任岳修虎同志主持召开会议，总体调度“六张网”各领域规划建设进展情况，研究部署下一阶段重点工作。会议听取“六张网”各牵头部门和资金、土地等要素保障部门工作情况介绍，研究会商当前面临的主要问题。会议强调，各有关部门要进一步做好规划方案衔接，抓紧出台配套政策，加快项目库建设和信息共享，加强重大项目调度和资金、土地等要素保障，支持“六网协同”新场景培育打造，研究制定明年工作计划，确保“六张网”建设高效有序推进。工业和信息化部、财政部、自然资源部、生态环境部、住房城乡建设部、交通运输部、水利部、中国人民银行、国务院
text_en: On November 5, 2026, Yue Xiuhu, Member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, chaired a meeting to coordinate overall progress in the planning and construction of the "six networks" across various sectors and to study and deploy key tasks for the next stage. The meeting heard introductions from the lead departments for each of the "six networks" and from departments responsible for funding, land and other element support, and discussed and consulted on the main problems currently faced. The meeting emphasized that relevant departments should further align planning schemes, promptly introduce supporting policies, accelerate project library development and information sharing, strengthen scheduling of major projects and support for funding, land and other elements, support the cultivation and creation of new scenarios for "six-network coordination," and study and formulate work plans for next year to ensure the efficient and orderly advancement of "six networks" construction.
